title: uv lock files
content: uv writes uv.lock with the exact versions; `uv sync` installs exactly what it says, so a fresh checkout gets the same packages as the author's machine.

title: Loki retention
content: Loki keeps logs for 30 days on the customer VMs; the compactor deletes older chunks and needs the folder /loki/compactor on the volume.

title: Bexio-Rechnungen per API
content: Rechnungen legt man in Bexio über die API v2 an, mit einem Personal Access Token pro Benutzer. Der Webshop erstellt so für jede Bestellung eine Rechnung.

title: Commit message format
content: Every commit message reads `type(scope): description` in English; the scope is required, e.g. `fix(api): handle null response`.

title: Azure quota requests
content: A new customer subscription needs eight Azure OpenAI quota forms at aka.ms/oai/stuquotarequest; approval takes two to five days, so file them on day one.

title: Steuerabzüge
content: Abziehen lassen sich die Säule 3a, Berufsauslagen und Weiterbildungskosten; die Belege gehören zur Steuererklärung.

title: Service names in Docker Compose
content: Containers in one Docker Compose network reach each other by service name, e.g. http://loki:3100 or reverse_proxy app:8080; localhost inside a container is the container itself.

title: Obsidian-Eigenschaften
content: Eigenschaften stehen im YAML-Frontmatter, ein Wert pro Zeile; ein Link in einer Eigenschaft braucht Anführungszeichen, sonst liest Obsidian ihn als Liste.

title: Bash outside the working directory
content: In a headless claude -p run, a Bash command on a path outside the session's working directory is refused even when the command is allowed; skills should use their own commands or the Read and Grep tools instead.
